portal_description:
The resource-agents packages provide the Pacemaker and RGManager service managers with a set of scripts. These scripts interface with several services to allow operating in a high-availability (HA) environment.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* [RFE] db2: add "skip_basic_sql_health_check" parameter to avoid failing on systems with high load [rhel-9.4.z] (JIRA:RHEL-123282)

* [RFE] db2: add "monitor_retries", "monitor_sleep", and "monitor_retry_all_errors" parameters to be able to avoid failing on first try [rhel-9.4.z] (JIRA:RHEL-123285)

* DB2 resource agent encounters "race condition" upon cluster re-integration [rhel-9.4.z] (JIRA:RHEL-123291)
